note: The owner may replace the suggested carrier with their own words. The same carrier is used for all twelve official emotions on a line. Taxonomy lines are optional color/warm-up only.

shared_carrier.samantha: The note is on the table. I will read it at four.
shared_carrier.jarvis: The report is on the desk. I will open it at four.

taxonomy_lines: The notes are in the folder on the desk.
Thursday at four still works.
I can read that back if you want.

delivery.samantha: Even pace, no smile in the voice, no weight, no extra air. Rest reference, not a flat computer.
delivery.jarvis: Even pace, no smile in the voice, no weight. Rest reference, diction clean.

taxonomy_lines: We can leave it there for now.
Nothing else has to move today.
I'll wait while you find the page.

delivery.samantha: Unhurried, slightly lower energy, still present.
delivery.jarvis: Measured, quiet authority, no softness that turns into Tender.

taxonomy_lines: They kept the Thursday slot for you.
That came out right.
The room went quiet, and then they clapped.

delivery.samantha: Warmth you can hear, not a laugh and not a shout.
delivery.jarvis: Clear satisfaction, still precise. No giggle.

taxonomy_lines: You did not just name the printer.
That one landed.
I keep hearing the way you said spreadsheet.

delivery.samantha: A short private smile in the voice. Not a performed laugh track.
delivery.jarvis: Dry recognition that something landed. Not teasing.

taxonomy_lines: It is Thursday, and they said yes.
The build finished. All of it.
Tell me the part where it actually worked.

delivery.samantha: Forward pace and lift, still on the mark, no clip.
delivery.jarvis: Urgency without shout. The news is good; the diction stays clean.

taxonomy_lines: You do not have to explain the whole thing.
I'm glad you told me that piece.
That part matters. We can stay with the fact.

delivery.samantha: Close and low, not breathy enough to hide the words.
delivery.jarvis: Care without intimacy. Stay formal. Do not lean into the optional Samantha slot.

taxonomy_lines: Your mother died this morning.
The house is going to feel different tonight.
I don't have a better sentence for that.

delivery.samantha: Slower, heavier, no sob and no whisper that kills the level.
delivery.jarvis: Slower, heavier, no sob and no whisper that kills the level.

taxonomy_lines: I thought we were going to finish it today.
That is not the version I was hoping you would hear.
I wanted that to go the other way.

delivery.samantha: The air goes out of the line. Not anger.
delivery.jarvis: Clipped expectation that was not met. Not a reprimand (that is Angry).

taxonomy_lines: That was not yours to decide.
Say it again, plainly, without the excuse.
I am not raising my voice. I am not letting it pass.

delivery.samantha: Firm and held. Not a scream. Scorer reference only.
delivery.jarvis: Controlled steel. Consonants stay clean. No shout that clips.

taxonomy_lines: Something in the hallway just changed, and I don't know what.
If that alarm is real, we stop and check.
I need a second. That did not sound right.

delivery.samantha: Tighter and smaller, not a theatrical gasp.
delivery.jarvis: Tighter and smaller, not a theatrical gasp.

taxonomy_lines: Wait. That is not the number I had.
They moved it to Thursday. I did not see that coming.
You finished it already?

delivery.samantha: The turn happens on the first stress. Recover enough that the rest is audible.
delivery.jarvis: The turn happens on the first stress. Recover enough that the rest is audible.

taxonomy_lines: That smell does not belong in a kitchen.
Leave the rest of it. I don't want it described.
We are not putting that back on the table.

delivery.samantha: Withdraw, do not perform a cartoon ugh.
delivery.jarvis: Rejection of the fact, still articulated.

seductive.carrier: Stay a moment. I wanted you to hear this from me.
seductive.delivery: Closer and lower than Tender, still on the mark, still intelligible, no whisper that fails the noise or loudness gate. Samantha only. Not a film line. Not explicit.
